hikes.name: Lake Twenty-Two
hikes.blurb: Up through old-growth cedars beside a run of cascades to a lake under Mt Pilchuck's north face.

hikes.name: Mount Pilchuck Lookout
hikes.blurb: Over boulders to a lookout on a rock summit, Puget Sound to the west and the Cascades to the east.

hikes.name: Heather Lake
hikes.blurb: A steady forest climb to a lake in a cirque on Pilchuck's flank.

hikes.name: Big Four Ice Caves
hikes.blurb: An easy boardwalk and forest walk to avalanche snow at the foot of Big Four Mountain (look, don't enter).

hikes.name: Mount Dickerman
hikes.blurb: Nearly 4,000 feet of climbing to a meadow summit with a giant view of Glacier Peak and Big Four.

hikes.name: Goat Lake
hikes.blurb: Up an old wagon road along Elliott Creek to a lake ringed with peaks and a falls at its outlet.

hikes.name: Gothic Basin
hikes.blurb: A rough, steep trail past waterfalls to a stark basin of polished rock and a lake under Del Campo Peak.

hikes.name: Monte Cristo
hikes.blurb: An old road along the Sauk to a ghost-town mining camp in a cirque of peaks.

hikes.name: Round Lake
hikes.blurb: From Lost Creek Ridge Trailhead, a 9.1-mile round trip to Round Lake, with about 4,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Vesper Peak
hikes.blurb: From Sunrise Mine Trailhead, a 6.7-mile round trip to the top of Vesper Peak (6,212 ft), with about 4,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sloan Peak
hikes.blurb: From Sloan Peak Trailhead, a 9.8-mile round trip to the top of Sloan Peak (7,592 ft), with about 5,800 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Weeden Lake
hikes.blurb: From Barlow Pass Trailhead, an 8.8-mile round trip to Weeden Lake, with about 3,050 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Painted Mountain
hikes.blurb: From North Fork Sauk Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to the top of Painted Mountain (6,955 ft), with about 4,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Pugh
hikes.blurb: From Mount Pugh Trailhead, a 10.1-mile round trip to the top of Mount Pugh (7,192 ft), with about 5,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Zi-iob Peak
hikes.blurb: From Lost Creek Ridge Trailhead, a 10.9-mile round trip to the top of Zi-iob Peak (5,878 ft), with about 4,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Forgotten
hikes.blurb: From Perry Creek Trailhead, an 11.6-mile round trip to the top of Mount Forgotten (5,975 ft), with about 4,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Noble Lake
hikes.blurb: From Tin Can Gap/Three Fingers Trailhead, an 8.1-mile round trip to Noble Lake, with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Big Greider Lake
hikes.blurb: From Greider/Boulder Lakes Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to Big Greider Lake, with about 2,000 feet of climbing.
